memberdef.type: typename detail::LagrangeInterpolatorResolver< ExecSpace, DataType, IdxRangeBasis, IdxRangeInterpGrid, ExtrapRules... >::type
memberdef.definition: using LagrangeInterpolator = typename detail::LagrangeInterpolatorResolver< ExecSpace, DataType, IdxRangeBasis, IdxRangeInterpGrid, ExtrapRules...>::type
memberdef.name: LagrangeInterpolator

briefdescription.para: A helper alias to define an instance of detail::LagrangeInterpolator.

detaileddescription.para: The helper allows ExtrapRules to be more general. It is a ddc::detail::TypeSeq<MinExtrapolationRule, MaxExtrapolationRule> pairing the extrapolation rules applied below/above the boundary. Each may be one of the tags in the ExtrapolationRule namespace (e.g. ExtrapolationRule::Periodic) or a custom, already-concrete extrapolation rule class.
